description: Finds products by name or brand across about 480 shops. Returns, for each match, the cheapest shop, how many shops carry it, our verdict on the price, and the product URL.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the shop charging the best price, e.g. "US", "CA", "DE".

currency.description: Currency for max_price: USD, CAD, EUR, GBP, AUD. Defaults to USD.

in_stock_only.description: Keep only products the cheapest shop actually has in stock.

max_price.description: Upper bound on the best price. Requires `currency` — we never convert, so this only filters products priced in that currency.

query.description: Product name or brand, e.g. "Meepo V5" or "Onewheel Pint".

vehicle.description: One of: electric-skateboard, electric-scooter, onewheel, electric-bike, skateboard.

name: search_products
title: Search tracked products
